fields.statement: At f06d3d29 built rhiza with go build -trimpath and a throwaway harness that opens daemonapp.New in modalshell with a runner exec'ing that built binary (rhiza daemon settings --json / rhiza daemon set --json -- <key> <value>) in a scratch git repo. Opened at paused=false, the Confirm rendered No selected; y, Enter, Enter ran 'daemon set -- rhiza.daemon.paused true', the shell closed with the set result, and git config rhiza.daemon.paused became true. Reopened, it opened at paused=true; n, Enter, Enter wrote false. Enter, Enter unchanged and y then Esc each closed the app with no daemon set and git config unchanged. go test -trimpath ./internal/tui/daemonapp/... also passes.

At f06d3d29, same built binary and harness against a scratch git repo: the Run limit field opened at maxRuns=2 (daemon.settings' default); Enter, Backspace, 7, Enter ran 'daemon set -- rhiza.daemon.maxRuns 7', closed the app and git config read 7; the next open started at 7. Flipping pause and typing 12 wrote both settings (paused true, maxRuns 12). Typing 0, x or an empty value and Enter showed '✗ must be a whole number of at least 1', kept the app open, ran no daemon set and left git config at 12.
